name: jinshuju-form-expert
description: Build forms and manage form data on Jinshuju (jinshuju.net) with natural language

displayDescription.en: Create forms for registration, questionnaires, appointments, and payments, and perform CRUD operations, as well as batch import and export of data, replacing backend login operations.
displayDescription.zh: 搭建报名、问卷、预约、收款等表单，增删改查、批量导入导出数据，替代登录后台操作。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我做一个训练营报名表，299 元一位，限 60 人报名
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please help me create a training camp registration form. It costs 299 yuan per person, and there's a limit of 60 people who can register.

quickPrompts.en: Please help me create a training camp registration form. It costs 299 yuan per person, and there's a limit of 60 people who can register.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一个训练营报名表，299 元一位，限 60 人报名

quickPrompts.en: Please help me analyze this month's satisfaction survey data to see what users care about most.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我分析这个月的满意度调研数据，看看用户最关心的问题是什么

quickPrompts.en: Check the registration forms from last week for those who haven't paid yet, and make a list.
quickPrompts.zh: 查一下上周报名表里还没缴费的人，列个清单
